title_en: Funny Stories from Life (6/20): Faking Sick and Running into My Deskmate's Mom
note_en: 一……就…… means "as soon as... then...": 小宇一想到明天要考数学，就决定装病 "The moment Xiao Yu remembered the math test tomorrow, he decided to fake being sick." English uses one connector ("as soon as"), while Chinese splits it into two: 一 before the first verb and 就 before the second, and the subject comes only once at the front.
